title: Seedance provenance-envelope wrapper for look-target adapter
purpose: Adds a traceability layer to Theo's look_branch_contract adapter (artifact 936bb216, commit cc73fb9). ProvenanceEnvelope carries the four fields needed to recover the chain from a downstream mesh or composite back to its source Seedance run. A partial envelope is accepted; the wrapper records the gap explicitly rather than silently dropping it.
